subject: EU onshore cutover + APAC staged burst — renewal coordination and term adjustments
messages:
From: Sara Mitchell <sara.mitchell@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion — EU onshore migration + APAC staged burst needs

Marissa / Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. As we approach renewal (end of Q3), NovaHealth needs to lock in two items together:

1) EU onshore cutover schedule and operational runbook (regulator wants data residency in place by Nov 1).
2) APAC staged burst capability for our Singapore pilots in Q4, with predictable pricing for peak events.

Attached is a short forecast (forecast_q3_q4.xlsx) showing expected token volumes and expected peak-day multipliers. Procurement and legal are on the thread — procurement will need the SOW amendment + pricing bands to evaluate budget impact.

Can Redwood propose a phased plan that ties the EU committed capacity timeline to the APAC burst entitlements, and indicate any SLA exceptions we should flag now?

Appreciate a quick plan we can take to procurement by next Wednesday (8/4).

— Sara
Sara Mitchell
VP, Cloud Ops | NovaHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Mitchell <sara.mitchell@novahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — EU onshore cutover + APAC staged burst needs

Sara — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. Short answers up front: yes, we can align the EU cutover and APAC staged burst under a single renewal amendment; we recommend a two-phase commitment model to minimize upfront spend while guaranteeing cutover windows.

High-level proposal (will send formal amendment draft):
- Phase A (EU onshore): Reserved capacity commitment for EU node(s) to meet regulator timeline. Cutover window target: Oct 15–Nov 1.
- Phase B (APAC staged burst): Burst pool entitlement with tiered pricing (base included in renewal + paid burst credits for >baseline). We support warm standby (cold burst to hot within 45 minutes) for the pilot stage.
- SLAs: EU primary will have 99.95% uptime SLA (standard for Dedicated); APAC burst is best-effort for warm-up speed, but we can offer a 99.5% availability commitment for staged-burst reservation booking.

I'll circulate a draft amendment (SOW + pricing table) by tomorrow EOD (8/2) and include the runbook appendix and a proposed canary cutover plan.

Quick Q for your team: is NovaHealth open to a 12-month commitment for the EU reserved tranche, or do you need a 6‑month bridge to start? That impacts pricing tiers.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Exec, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0198
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: EU cutover capacity planning (internal)

Marissa / Karthik — looping in Karthik for capacity and ops sequencing. Notes from my side:
- If NovaHealth wants EU primary by Nov 1, we need node allocation and DSN provisioning by Sep 10 to run integration validation.
- For APAC staged burst, we should propose a burst credit bucket that rolls over monthly for the first 3 months; that reduces procurement friction.
- I can sketch the pricing bands and lead with 6‑month bridge pricing vs 12‑month committed discount.

Karthik — can you confirm the warm-standby warmup times we can guarantee for the Singapore region, and whether we need additional pre-warm seats for canary traffic?

— Ben
From: Sara Mitchell <sara.mitchell@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com, Tom Haynes <tom.haynes@novalegal.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — EU onshore cutover + APAC staged burst needs

Thanks — a couple clarifications from procurement side:
- We prefer a 6‑month EU bridge with a firm plan to extend to 12 months after cutover verification. Budget constraints mean we cannot commit 12 months upfront.
- For APAC, the pilot will run spikes up to 8x baseline for a handful of days in Q4 — we need clear bucket pricing and an overage cadence (per-day or per-hour billing?).
- Legal requests: please send the amendment PDF that procurement can push to DocuSign; Tom will review redlines.

Attaching the updated forecast for Q3/Q4 (forecast_q3_q4.xlsx) with hourly peak samples.

Sara
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Mitchell <sara.mitchell@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-04T17:18:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed amendment + pricing bands attached

Sara / procurement team — attaching the first-draft amendment and a short pricing appendix. Key points called out in the draft (attachment: amendment-draft-v1.pdf):
- EU bridge: 6 months reserved-capacity commitment to cover cutover + integration validation; option to convert to 12 months within the bridge window at a retroactive discount.
- APAC burst: monthly burst credits with a per-hour overage rate; for pilot we recommend a 3-month rolling bucket with rollover up to 25% to avoid frequent invoicing.
- Cutover sequencing: milestones & verification steps tied to payment schedule (milestone 1: infra provisioning; milestone 2: canary validation; milestone 3: full cutover).
- SLAs: EU primary 99.95% uptime; APAC burst availability guarantee for reserved burst windows (99.5%) with service credits for missed windows.

Links / references: HubSpot deal ND-2026-081 (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ND-2026-081). DocuSign link will be generated after procurement confirms redline window.

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement / Legal review (Tom) — please send any redlines by 8/6 EOD.
2) Ops tech review: Karthik to confirm warmup timing and whether we need pre-warmed capacity for canary days.
3) Finalize amendment and issue DocuSign envelope.

Attaching: amendment-draft-v1.pdf; redlines-sow.docx (internal).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Exec, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Sara Mitchell <sara.mitchell@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com, Tom Haynes <tom.haynes@novalegal.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed amendment + pricing bands attached

Marissa — got the draft and pricing appendix, thanks. Tom will kick off legal review today; procurement will aim to have budget sign-off by 8/10. We like the 6-month bridge with conversion option — that should work for budget committee.

Confirming next steps on our end: legal redlines by 8/6; procurement to return to you by 8/10 with final approval or a follow-up ask. If all looks good, we can aim for a DocuSign envelope the week of 8/16.

Quick note (for ops): we include hourly peak samples in the attached forecast to validate the burst bucket sizing — if Redwood needs any additional telemetry during the pilot window, let us know and we can enable a debug stream.

Thanks,
Sara
